integrity: The algebraic identities, Sturm counts, isolating intervals, and finite-field irreducibility test are reproducible from the embedded verifier using exact arithmetic. Numerical decimals are descriptive only.
scientific_limitations: Exact identification is restricted to the k=6, |A|=k, I3 weakly periodic branch of the cited Ising model. The measure-count theorem is inherited from the primary source; no claim is made about all weakly periodic states, extremality, or thermodynamic dominance.
title: Exact degree-eleven phase boundary for order-six weakly periodic Ising states
